notes.title: v0.36 - Beta Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/017f6ec455f8ec6d753ffaf9413c6ef0c0b70b16.jpg

It's been a busy month for the Cloudfire Studios team, first with Dreamhack in Anaheim as a part of the Indie Playground and then PAX East in Boston before returning to New Zealand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/d9fe447a07cd8b8fc373c2ba7eab1647ae64f01a.png

We've also started seeing some coverage of the beta versions of the game, with an increasingly active group of beta players providing great feedback and competing for top spots on our leaderboards. Everyone is welcome to join the Starport Delta Discord and talk about the game, or request to join the beta!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/9318d5a709c1d71f912a8891193e726b51efce31.png

There's been a lot added to Starport Delta since our last news post, and as we count down the last week until release, we thought we'd share!
